data.topic: Fix 2 failing TestFetchDoc tests in Gemini MCP server - tests fail because DOCUMENTS dict doesn't have a 'claude' key in test environment
data.what: Fix TestFetchDoc tests that assume 'claude' key exists in DOCUMENTS dict
data.problem: DOCUMENTS is built dynamically by _discover_documents() and only includes keys for files that exist at PROJECT_ROOT. Tests assume 'claude' key is always present, but CLAUDE.md doesn't exist in the test environment.
data.why: 2 tests fail on every run, masking real regressions
data.end_goal: All TestFetchDoc tests pass regardless of which files exist at PROJECT_ROOT
data.complexity_reasoning: Test fixture issue in one file — tests need to handle dynamic DOCUMENTS dict instead of assuming specific keys exist
